fid.description: Automatically generated compulsory geopackage identifier, not meaningful and subject to change

NAME.description: Name, normalised to modern spelling, in modern language variant

NAME_DISAMB.description: Name extension, for disambiguating eponymous (but unrelated) localities

SHORT_ID.description: Alphanumerical identifiers of all the localities within the area, semi-colon separated

PARISH_ID.description: Alphanumerical identifier, linked to locality that includes the parish church. Multiple parishes within the area may be semi-colon separated

URBAN.description:
Urban status:
0 no urban status
1 (privileged) urban status, demarcated territory (e.g. enceinte, moat)
2 (privileged) urban status, non- or unclear demarcated territory (estimation of build-up area)
3 (non-privileged) urban status, demarcated territory (e.g. enceinte, moat)
4 (non-privileged) urban status, non- or unclear demarcated territory (estimation of build-up area)
5 (privileged) urban or liberty status, no demarcated territory, maintained rural character
9 extra muros, area beyond territory with (non-)demarcated urban status

KM2.description: Size of the area in km2

KM2_LANDSC_0.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 0 cultivatable land (e.g. residential/agricultural)

KM2_LANDSC_1.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 1 dunes or sandy soils

KM2_LANDSC_2.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 2 mud flats or marshes

KM2_LANDSC_3.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 3 forests

KM2_LANDSC_4.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 4 heath or moorland

KM2_LANDSC_7.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 7 fresh or coastal water, navigable for small vessels

KM2_LANDSC_8.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 8 fresh water, navigable for larger vessels

KM2_LANDSC_9.description: Size of the area in km2, for which LANDSCAPE = 9 open sea, navigable for larger vessels

ADM0.description: Highest administrative level, typically England (ENG), France (FRA), Holy Roman Empire (HRR). In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM1.description: Second-highest administrative level, typically duchies, counties, prince-bishoprics. Two-letter code, referring to any of the predefined regions. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM2.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM3.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM4.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM5.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM6.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM7.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM8.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ADM9.description: Further administrative subdivisions (to be defined for each ADM1). Not necessarily hierarchical. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

HIGH_JURISD.description: Unique identifier referring to the name of the jurisdiction administrating high justice (ius gladii). In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

MID_JURISD.description: Unique identifier referring to the name of the jurisdiction administrating middle justice. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

LOW_JURISD.description: Unique identifier referring to the name of the jurisdiction administrating low justice. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ARCH_DIOC.description: Name archdiocese. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

DIOCESE.description: Name diocese. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ARCH_DEAN.description: Name archdeanery. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

DEANERY.description: Name deanery. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ARCH_DIOC_1561.description: Name archdiocese after the reorganisation of the bishoprics in 1559/1561. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

DIOCESE_1561.description: Name diocese after the reorganisation of the bishoprics in 1559/1561. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

ARCH_DEAN_1561.description: Name archdeanery after the reorganisation of the bishoprics in 1559/1561. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

DEANERY_1561.description: Name deanery after the reorganisation of the bishoprics in 1559/1561. In case of divided or contested rule, separated by semi-colon

TIME_START.description: Start date (year) for the polygon. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exact start date for the boundary. The date is used to handle and disambiguate multiple instances of a boundary polygon of a locality through time.

TIME_END.description: End date (year) for the polygon. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exact end date for the boundary. The date is used to handle and disambiguate multiple instances of a boundary polygon of a locality through time.

TYPE.description:
Type of polygon:
0 administrative and/or judicial entity (e.g. city, lordship, or meaningful subdivision thereof)
1 religious entity (e.g. parish)
2 combination
8 exclusively natural feature (LANDSCAPE 1-9)
9 unclear

QUALITY.description:
Quality of polygon:
0 based primarily on historical reconstructions (near contemporary)
1 based primarily on historical reconstructions (non-contemporary)
2 based primarily on modern boundaries
3 estimated using for substantial part geographical or natural features (e.g. roads, rivers)
4 estimated using for substantial part historical boundaries (e.g. cadastral sections)
8 combination of sources, not possible to single out one primary type of source
9 unidentified location

SOURCE.description: Sources for the polygon, separated by semi-solon (Author-date format, further defined in bibliography)

REMARKS.description: General remarks regarding the shape or construction of the polygon

GeoNames.description: GeoNames identifier (preferably associated with the polygon area)

wikipedia.description: Wikipedia reference, with language prefix (preferably associated with the polygon area)

wikidata.description: Wikidata Q identifier (preferably associated with the polygon area)

NIS_CODE_1800.description: Alphanumerical code for Belgian (historical) municipalities for the year 1800

NIS_CODE_xxxx.description: Alphanumerical code for Belgian (historical) municipalities for different years, combined with the relevant year

insee.description: Numerical code for French municipalities for the year 2017

LuxCom.description: Combines the codes for the 'Communes' (001-130) and subsequent 'Sections Cadastrales' (A-H) for Luxembourg, based on the early nineteenth century cadastral maps (Urpläne / Feuilles cadastrale historique). Combined cadastral section numbers are semi-colon separated

acode_1840.description: Amsterdamse Code (for Dutch (historical) municipalities) for the year 1840

CBS_1840.description: CBS Code (for Dutch municipalities) for the year 1840

KadGem_1832.description: Alphanumerical identifier for Dutch cadastral municipalities in 1832 (Limburg: 1834), used by Rijksdienst voor Cultureel Erfgoed and HisGIS.nl
